morning.english: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed.
In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

morning.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ
morning.english: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep.
All praise is due to Allah.

morning.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
morning.english: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things competent.

morning.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
morning.english: We have entered morning and the dominion belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner.

morning.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
morning.english: O Allah, by You we enter the morning, by You we enter the evening, by You we live, by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

morning.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
morning.english: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no deity except Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.

evening.english: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed.

evening.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
evening.english: We have entered evening and the dominion belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner.

evening.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
evening.english: O Allah, by You we enter the evening, by You we enter the morning, by You we live, by You we die, and to You is the return.
All praise is due to Allah.

evening.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
evening.english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

evening.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
evening.english: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

evening.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
evening.english: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no deity except Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.

post_prayer.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
post_prayer.english: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Owner of majesty and honor.
All praise is due to Allah.

post_prayer.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
post_prayer.english: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things competent.

post_prayer.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
post_prayer.english: There is no power and no strength except with Allah.

post_prayer.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
post_prayer.english: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad.
